patch_list: Disables the PairIP license check so a re-signed build of Photon Camera starts instead of being refused. Required by every other patch.

Forces the premium entitlement to always resolve as active, unlocking the VIP LUT packs, the AI photo review and the LUT Creator, with or without a Play purchase and with or without a network connection.
